svg.title: Capability matrix
svg.desc: 75 references against 32 capabilities. Filled: primary. Ring: supporting. Square: tested by a fixture here. Dot: not applicable. Generated from the registry.
svg.text: 75 references × 32 capabilities, from pinned documentation. No ratings: a mark says what a tool is for, not how good it is.
Unverified capabilities are not drawn: every mark has pinned evidence.
I. Motion films, explainers and engines (source D)
Source: registry/repositories.json. Regenerate with python scripts/render-matrix.py.
